title: Batista's 1957 reunion of Cuban musicians in Havana
summary: Machito flew with Tito Puente, whom he and Mario had pushed to attend, to a two-week gathering of Cuban musicians.

story.theme_name: Still working: current gigs, upcoming projects and plans
story.community_name: What's next: upcoming tours, records and plans

blocks.x: Okay, in 1957 Batista, Fulgencio Batista, asked for all Cuban musicians around the world to go back for a two-week holiday. There was a reunion. You went, Mario Bauza went, a lot of Cubans. Chombo Silva came in from France or wherever he was at. They came from all over the world. Do you remember that ....
Tell me about that. How did you get to go and Tito Puente told me that it was you and Mario Bauza that was responsible for him going.

Well, because it sounds like unbelievable because people they live with so many reservations. They never say the truth about the next person because they consider that you are going to be shadowed by .... but we don't believe in that, we ahh, not that we are good people,

just we respect other people's talent and other people's desire to - for progress. I love progress, and we consider the music was -- his version of Cuban music was good and that he deserved be exposed to the other Cubans that there was all over the world and that he.... I think it was the first time that he went to Cuba.
Yes, and he did do a lot for Cuban music.
His modern versions of Cuban tunes were one of the best.
Okay. How did you go there, by plane or boat?
Was Tito Puente in the plane with you?
Ah - Ha. Do you remember anything about that .....
Oh, definetely. Ahhh we had a tremendous time in Havana. Good hotels, good transportation ...

Yeah, but, all right, Cuban musicians from all over the world went there to reunite. Did any music come out of that meeting? Give a number that happened in that reunion of fifty years of Cuban music in Havana.
Was a tremendous experience and very sentimental because I met people that I haven't seen for twenty-five years.
